title: Not All Pairs Align: Caption-Guided Audio-Visual Contrastive Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.32399v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We address the problem of learning audio-visual representations from co-occurring modalities. Multimodal contrastive learning typically assumes that paired observations provide shared views of the same underlying information. While this may be true for datasets collected in constrained environments, it does not always hold. For instance, co-occurring audio and visual signals can differ substantially in their content due to off-screen sounds. Nevertheless, standard contrastive objectives treat all paired samples as equally aligned. In this work, we propose Caption Guided Alignment Aware Loss (CGAAL), a model-agnostic objective that leverages modality-specific captions to estimate semantic agreement between audio and video. CGAAL uses these agreement scores to weight the contribution of each positive pair. A warm-up period and gradual thresholding strategy progressively introduce this alignment-aware training signal. translated_title: 并非所有样本对都对齐：字幕引导的音视频对比学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究从共现模态中学习音视频表示的问题。多模态对比学习通常假设成对观测提供的是同一底层信息的共享视图，这对于在受限环境中收集的数据集可能成立，但并不总是如此。例如，由于画外音的存在，共现的音频与视觉信号在内容上可能存在显著差异。然而，标准对比学习目标将所有配对样本视为同等对齐。在这项工作中，我们提出了字幕引导的对齐感知损失（CGAAL），这是一种与模型无关的目标函数，利用特定模态的字幕来估计音频与视频之间的语义一致性。CGAAL使用这些一致性分数来为每个正样本对的贡献加权，并通过预热期和渐进阈值策略逐步引入这种对齐感知的训练信号。我们展示了……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种模型无关的对比学习目标CGAAL，利用模态特定字幕估计音视频间的语义一致性，并据此为正样本对加权，从而解决了画外音等因素导致的音视频内容不匹配问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes CGAAL, a model-agnostic contrastive learning objective that uses modality-specific captions to estimate semantic agreement between audio and video and weights positive pairs accordingly, addressing the misalignment caused by off-screen sounds.
